text:
kai: Follow-up from postmortem: we saw three recurring signals — missing spans, overcount in daily aggregates, and intermittent ETL stalls. Need owners + short deadlines.

maria: I'll take aggregates. root cause looks like tag normalization change. filing TKT-7201. Plan: add dedupe by trace_id and nightly parity check. PR by Mon, canary Wed.

alec: I'll handle ETL stalls. initial mitigation: increase consumer batch size, add jittered backoff, and a staging stress test. PR Thu, deploy Fri. If unresolved may need partition rebalance and 30m maintenance.

devops-bot: alert: missing_spans_rate >0.5% triggered for service=api at 2027-04-18T14:12:03Z. Linked: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/TKT-7202

kai: @maria can you also prototype a 7-day-median drift job that auto-opens a ticket when delta >12%? @alec add a Prom rule to tag recurring ETL stalls when same partition shows >3 events in 7d.

maria: prototype SQL sketch:
```
SELECT metric, cnt, median
FROM (
  SELECT metric, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM metrics_raw WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL '24 hours' GROUP BY metric
) t JOIN metrics_7d_median m USING(metric)
WHERE ABS(t.cnt - m.median) / NULLIF(m.median,0) > 0.12;
```
I'll wire to daily cron and auto-create TKT-7203. ETA Fri.

alec: Prom rule I'll add: `increase(kafka_consumer_lag[10m]) > 1000` and a recurrence label if same partition matches >3 hits in 7d. Will create runbook entry for partition rebalance.

kai: Good. Please update postmortem doc with owners, deadlines, rollback steps. Reconvene next Tue 09:30 to check canaries. If blockers, ping me. :thumbsup:
